text:
Alex: Heads up — after yesterday's release I'm seeing a sustained token/sec drop (~35%) for the continuous-batcher path on prod-gpu pools and a 95p latency spike. Rollout currently paused for that cluster.

Maria: Oof. Any quick correlates? kernel changes, prefetch, kv hit?

Alex: Started when we merged runtime:refactor-prefetch (commit 0b7a9f). Timeline: deploy 02:10 UTC -> drop at 02:14 and tail loops start ~02:18. CI perf didn't blow up but can reproduce on perf-staging with traffic profile.

ci-bot: perf/regression detected: job=ctb-e2e-seqlen-512, delta_tokens_per_sec=-34.6%, p95_latency+68%. See: https://ci.internal/reports/0b7a9f

Kevin: I ran a quick flamegraph on staging. Looks like scheduler enqueue/dequeue time increases and majority of time is spent in kernel-selection fallback path (memcopy fallback). Snippet from pprof: 
```
# pprof flame (top callers)
runtime::schedule_enqueue  42.1%
runtime::choose_kernel_variant  31.0%  // falls back to generic_memcpy
kernel::generic_memcopy  24.3%
```

Sunita: Also noticed KV cache hit rate on affected routing dropped from 88% -> 56% after the prefetch heuristic tweak. Keys appear to miss on small batch warmups. That explains more memcopy work per request.

Maria: So two interacting regressions: prefetch heuristic reduces effective KV hits on steady traffic -> smaller effective batches -> kernel selector sees different seqlen distribution and picks fallback path that is slower.

Alex: Repro script I used (staging):
```
./perf/run_ctb.sh --profile --seq-len 512 --qps 120 --model redwood-v1
# collect /tmp/pprof.{pid}.svg
```
Output shows queueing age jumps and coalesce size drops from ~14 -> ~5 tokens per batch.

Kevin: I bisected offline to a9c3f2..0b7a9f and confirmed the prefetch threshold change in 0b7a9f is the inflection. The kernel selector change in 0a1d2e earlier made fallback more likely when batch <8. So combined -> big perf hit.

Sunita: For mitigation I pushed a hotfix branch that: (1) reverts the prefetch threshold tweak; (2) adds a short-circuit in choose_kernel_variant to prefer fused-kernel if kv_miss_rate > 0.3 and batch_size < 8. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/runtime/pulls/3421

Maria: Nice. Can we add a regression test to CI that simulates low-kv-hit traffic and asserts <=10% tokens/sec delta? We need to catch this earlier.

Alex: Agreed. I'll add a perf test harness to the nightly matrix. Also proposing an observability metric: coalesce.avg_batch_size and kernel_variant_ratio per model.

ci-bot: deploy paused for prod-gpu-3 (rollout hold placed by @Alex).

Kevin: Short term: revert 0b7a9f on prod and promote hotfix to staging, run smoke for 2 hours. Long term: add pre-commit perf golden and a small canary with coalesce metrics gating.

Sunita: I'll run KV warmup experiments to tune prefetch so hit rate stays >80% for mixed seqlen. Will post results in this thread.

Alex: Plan: 1) revert in prod (ASAP) 2) merge hotfix (if smoke ok) 3) add CI perf test + observability metrics 4) follow-up PR to tune heuristic.

Maria: Thanks everyone — this explains the tail. Please ping if you need extra on-call for the revert. :thumbsup:

Kevin: Adding action items to the incident doc and will attach pprof svgs.

Sunita: attaching initial kv-hit plots to the ticket (link pasted).

Alex: closing loop — revert queued, ETA deploy in 15m.
